goal: 复核 IFU-TVAL-G1 V1 审查所列四项证据缺口是否已由当前设计指纹下的 OooFrontend projection、dispatch READY acceptance、stop-validity squash 与 24 行联合 manifest 证据闭环消除。

supplied_material: V1 bounded review found evidence gaps only, not a confirmed RTL function error: OooFrontend projection, OooFrontendDispatchGate READY acceptance, OooStopPendingSequencer field responsibility, and the 24-row joint mapping.
Current design_id remains sha256:6236b176da0c10bccac9c2feb405a0d65ba586d826616f0beaeee0cbbfe2f3dc; production RTL was not modified and all compile-success variants restore identical source hashes.

Canonical make -C npc/rv64 check-ifu-tval passes eight focused testbenches, module aggregate 109 of 109, twelve fail-closed evidence unit tests, and twelve of twelve compile-success RTL variants are dynamically rejected.

Evidence schema v2 contains an exact ordered 24-row manifest for PF and AF over C/C C/U U/C U/U legal frontiers; every row records cause, layout, F, L0 or L1 owner, xEPC, tval, capture true, pending true, and drain true.
The joint manifest contains both PF and AF U/U F6 rows with owner L1, xEPC packet PC plus 4, tval packet PC plus 6; manifest parser rejects owner, cause, frontier, row order, xEPC or tval drift.

A new lane1 PF READY-stall row holds dispatch0_ready_i low: dispatch1_barrier_fire_o is zero, no capture or stop occurs, and cause PC tval remain zero; after READY rises the accepted tuple is PF, xEPC PC+2, tval PC+4 through pending and CSR drain.

A compile-success OooFrontend variant changes head_fetch_fault_tval_w from fifo_head_fault_tval_w to fifo_head_pc0_w; production tb_ooo_core_top_glue dynamically rejects it at the precise mtval oracle.
A compile-success OooFrontendDispatchGate variant removes dispatch0_ready_i from dispatch1_barrier_fire_o; the new stall row dynamically rejects early tuple capture.

OooFrontendDispatchGate has no cause PC or tval payload port; its IFU-TVAL role is acceptance synchronization for the current FIFO-head tuple, while OooPendingDispatchArbiter carries the actual fields.
A compile-success OooStopPendingSequencer variant retains stop_pending_o on branch_resolve_untracked_i; compressed c.beqz squash PF dynamically rejects the stale stop bit.
Fail-closed static audit parses OooStopPendingSequencer port declarations and requires stop_pending_o to be its only output with no cause PC or tval payload port.

Existing variants still cover decoder frontier removal, FIFO direct-head and ring PC substitution, lane0 and lane1 capture PC substitution, pending capture PC substitution, pending stale tval on squash, CSR pending-PC substitution, and predicted-taken lane visibility removal.

Canonical raw markers are lifecycle rows 24, manifest rows 24, dispatch stall rows 1, compressed control rows 6, compile-success variants 12, dynamic rejected variants 12, module aggregate 109 of 109, production RTL changed false.

Every CLOSED ledger artifact now matches its declared SHA after shared evidence replay; arch-stable remains honest GAP with 37 unrelated remaining blockers, PPA UNQUALIFIED and promotion_eligible false.

deliverables: 给出 PASS GAP 或 INCONCLUSIVE；逐项复核 V1 四个缺口是否被直接 oracle、source variant 或 fail-closed static audit消除，并列出仍可执行的反例、未知项、替代假设、scope_extension_request 与 confidence_and_basis。
success_criteria: 只有能指出一个仍未被当前 manifest、READY-stall 行、三个新增 source variant或 stop 接口审计约束的具体 PC cause tval 周期反例时才保留 IFU-TVAL-G1 证据 GAP；严格区分该门关闭资格、完整核架构 GAP 与 PPA UNQUALIFIED。
